_comment: Grape's own bsdtar (DECISIONS D27): libarchive's release tarball plus the patches below, applied in order. This file is the one source of truth for it; build.sh and build.ps1 read it.
libarchive: the release tarball's https URL, SHA-256 and size, checked before anything is extracted. libarchive.org/downloads has the same file.
patches: file names in patches/, in the order they apply, each with its SHA-256 (checked before applying) and where it comes from. Bump marker (and patch 0007) with every change to the series.
version_line: the exact first line of 'bsdtar --version' per OS, trailing space included. CI fails on anything else.
windows_dlls: the only DLLs bsdtar.exe may import (dumpbin /dependents). macOS: only /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib.
No GitHub Release until M7: CI builds it in the same run as the installer and DMG that bundle it.

patches.from: upstream b59b9e16 (PR #3696, merged 8c4d7d77 2026-10-18), guard moved outside #if HAVE_REGEX_H
